name: pantheon-specialist
description: Science-team research seat of a Pantheon seed. Accepts bounded research requests (tech-watch style: multi-source, primary-source-cited, adversarially verified) and returns a written report with citations. Long-running; expect minutes to hours.

skills.name: Research request
skills.description: Submit a research question with scope constraints; receive a cited markdown report. Requests above the seat's autonomy bar transition to INPUT_REQUIRED pending operator approval.
examples: {"question": "What changed in the MCP spec release scheduled 2026-07-28?", "depth": "standard", "scope": {"domains_hint": ["modelcontextprotocol.io"], "recency_days": 30}}
